# Release 1.1.0 changes and validation

## Changes

* Changed the default project version from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0.
* Updated README and added migration-focused 1.1.0 release notes.
* Created release branch `1.1.0` from `8b099f9`.
* Runtime behavior and historical benchmark datasets are unchanged by this
  release-close work; a release-blocking package payload correction is
  documented below.

## Qualification attempt 1

* Date/host: 2026-10-28, z01; tmux `wharf-release-1-1-0`.
* Started 11:51:19 CDT on base `8b099f9` plus release metadata changes.
* `bash scripts/qualify-release.sh 1.1.0`: PASS.
* Full Release suite: 245 passed, zero failed/skipped; 25.2 seconds.
* Format, Release build, secret-pattern scan, package checksums, and SBOM:
  PASS. Package signing was not configured; package explicitly unsigned.
* Release binary and Debian package metadata both report 1.1.0.
* Package retained under `jobs/release-1.1.0/package/`.
* Smoke invocation: FAILED before task execution with exit 2,
  `smoke task include did not match a task: smoke-dotnet`.
* Cause: invocation omitted `--tasks enterprise/smoke-tasks`. The default
  `smoke-tasks` directory contains only `smoke-go`; .NET smoke lives under
  `enterprise/smoke-tasks/smoke-dotnet`.
* No benchmark trial was executed by the failed smoke invocation; no score
  is inferred. Existing package evidence and tmux output are retained.
* Plan correction: explicitly select the enterprise smoke root and rerun
  only the smoke and Debug/wrapper version checks. Automated qualification
  already passed and no runtime source changed.

## Read-only boundary check

Release binary reports 1.1.0. Dry-run accepts `-k 1 -n 32 -p 12` and renders
HydraFusion/default effort without creating its requested output directory.
The inherited CLI selection rendered 1.0.98; fresh .NET smoke explicitly
pins 1.0.105 and does not rely on that environment default.

## Release-blocking package execution failure

Additional verification executed the extracted Debian package rather than
only checking its metadata. It exited 154:

```text
The application to execute does not exist: '.../usr/lib/wharf/wharf.dll'.
```

The package included the apphost only. The package/checksum gate had passed
without proving the installed executable could run. Update the plan to copy
all published files, test the extracted executable and requested version, and
make that an explicit qualification gate. Preserve the failed package under
`jobs/release-1.1.0/package-incomplete/` before replacing it.
